tool_args.rationale: The ten observations span input and gradient at the target horizon. A fitted saturating rational response tests the bridge-like stationary mechanism on fresh data without claiming unidentified horizon dynamics.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed response saturates with input and varies nonlinearly with gradient, unlike either recalled alternative.
All paid rows have the same horizon and initial state, so its dynamic parameters are not identifiable from these observations.
The available batch has already been acquired and supplied no variation in horizon or initial state; confirmation of the stationary response is the useful next test.
